blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models have advanced rapidly, but most remain optimized for single-image inputs. Multi-image reasoning is costly because each image adds many visual tokens, increasing encoding and attention demands. Existing techniques that address the above issue, including visual token pruning, token merging, visual token compression, learned resampling, hierarchical compression, retrieval-augmented visual reasoning, and memory-based architectures, have largely been designed for single-image scenarios, where redundancy is primarily spatial and local. Multi-image reasoning introduces additional challenges: redundancy may occur across images, task-relevant evidence may be sparse or distributed, and aggressive per-image compression can remove details needed for comparison, counting, temporal reasoning, retrieval, or evidence grounding. Moreover, existing token-reduction methods are often either (i) training-free but inference-inefficient, typically relying on accessing attention matrices to get token-importance that may be impractical to access with memory-efficient attention implementations such as FlashAttention, or (ii) training-dependent, requiring the base MLLM to be retrained or adapted to a new compressed-token paradigm. In this work, we study scalable multi-image reasoning and understanding without retraining the base model and without accessing attention matrices at inference time. To this end, we propose mmVB, a lightweight plug-and-play module that assigns query-conditioned per-image token budgets via cross-image context, adding only 1.6M trainable parameters while reducing visual input tokens by 9x. This reduction yields 5x faster time-to-first-token and 7x fewer prefill FLOPs, while maintaining 94.4% of full-resolution accuracy across eight multi-image reasoning benchmarks.

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Introduction and Motivation. Existing multi-image methods scale poorly: dense attention breaks FlashAttention and excludes API-only models, token merging disrupts positional encodings and cross-image reasoning, and video-style compression assumes frame similarity. Our pre-encoding predictor instead assigns query-conditioned token budgets using only pixels, enabling compatibility with any MLLM, including closed models.

blocks.en: Although current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can accept multiple images as input, the problem of scaling them efficiently to many-image settings remains underexplored. Multi-image understanding and reasoning is inherently challenging: the model must identify relevant visual evidence, compare information across images, and aggregate details that may be distributed over the input set. Scaling this capability further increases the difficulty, as every additional image contributes visual tokens and raises memory, latency, and compute costs. This limitation is especially important in real-world applications. For instance, a catalog-oriented LLM may need to process multiple product images to understand item attributes, compare variants, and answer user queries, while operating within a constrained inference budget.
blocks.zh: 虽然目前的多模式大型语言模型(MLLMs)可以接受多幅图像作为输入,但是高效地将其缩放到多图像设置上的问题仍然没有得到充分探讨. 多图像理解和推理本质上具有挑战性:模型必须确定相关的视觉证据,比较图像之间的信息,以及可能分布于输入集的汇总细节. 扩大这种能力会进一步增加难度,因为每一个额外的图像都贡献出视觉标志并增加内存、耐久性和计算成本。 这一限制在现实世界的应用中特别重要. 例如,一个面向目录的LLM可能需要处理多个产品图像,以了解项目属性,比较变体并回答用户询问,同时在有限的推论预算范围内运行.

blocks.en: Visual token redundancy has been widely studied, with many works showing that multimodal language models can operate effectively, and in some cases even better, with fewer visual tokens. Existing approaches typically reduce tokens through pruning, merging, or learned compression, either in a training-free manner or by training additional modules. However, applying these methods to scalable multi-image reasoning presents three key challenges: i) Limited systems scalability. Many training-free methods rely on accessing attention matrices, often across multiple layers, to estimate token importance. This can be memory-intensive and difficult to integrate with optimized inference kernels such as FlashAttention, which avoid materializing dense attention maps. Production systems often depend on such kernels for speed and memory efficiency, meaning that methods requiring explicit access to dense attention matrices may be impractical at scale. Token merging can also disrupt positional structure, and correcting the resulting positional encoding mismatch often requires additional architectural changes. ii) Insufficient study of multi-image reasoning. Most token-reduction methods are designed for single-image inputs, where task-relevant regions are often spatially localized. For example, when answering “What is the species of the animal in this image?” , attention may concentrate on the animal region, making pruning or merging relatively effective, often even from early layers. In the multi-image reasoning case, questions such as “What is the difference between image 1 and image 2?” may require preserving fine-grained details across both images until later stages of reasoning. In such cases, aggressive early pruning can remove evidence that only becomes important after cross-image comparison. iii) Training dependence and distribution shift. Some approaches require training adapters, compressed tokens, or modified visual-language interfaces, which can change the input distribution seen by the language model or require adapting its weights. This is problematic when the goal is to scale existing MLLMs without retraining the base model, not overfitting to a particular dataset, or altering the model’s original reasoning behavior. Moreover, recent evidence shows that simple image downsampling consistently outperforms sophisticated post-encoding compression methods at matched token budgets Liao et al. (2026) , questioning the fundamental value of operating after the vision encoder. Together, these limitations suggest the need for a token-reduction strategy that is scalable, compatible with efficient inference, applicable to multi-image inputs, and usable with frozen multimodal language models.
blocks.zh: 视觉符号冗余被广泛研究,许多作品显示多式语言模型可以有效运行,在某些情况下甚至更好,视觉符号较少. 现行办法通常通过无培训方式或通过培训其他模块来进行搜索、合并或学习压缩来减少象征性值。 然而,应用这些方法来进行可伸缩的多图像推理提出了三大挑战: (一)有限的系统可伸缩性. 许多无培训方法都依赖经常跨多层访问关注矩阵来估计象征性的重要性。 这可能具有内存密集性,难以与FlashAttenty等最优化的推想内核相融合,避免实现密集的注意力图. 生产系统在速度和内存效率方面往往依赖这种内核,这意味着要求明确访问密集的注意力矩阵的方法在规模上可能不切实际. blocks.en: A natural solution is to reduce the number of visual tokens before language-model processing, and ideally even before the visual encoder incurs the full cost of processing all image content. Under a constrained-budget setting, we formulate the problem as estimating the minimum relative visual scale needed for the downstream language model to answer a visual question correctly. The scale estimator must itself be lightweight and avoid introducing additional memory overhead, since the goal is to enable efficient reasoning at scale. To this end, we propose mmVB , a lightweight plug-and-play module that assigns input-dependent visual budgets across images conditioned on both the image set and the question. Rather than applying a fixed resolution or token budget to every image, Visual Budgeter estimates how much visual detail each image requires for the downstream reasoning task. The motivation of this work is illustrated in Figure 1 . Our main contributions are: - We formulate scalable multi-image reasoning as a visual budget allocation problem, where the goal is to estimate the minimum image scale needed for accurate downstream reasoning under a constrained compute budget. We propose mmVB , a scalable, lightweight plug-and-play module with only 1.6M trainable parameters that assigns question-conditioned visual budgets across images without retraining the base MLLM. - This Visual Budgeter reduces visual input tokens by 9 × \times , yielding 5 × \times faster time-to-first-token and 7 × \times fewer prefill FLOPs. - We evaluate Visual Budgeter across eight multi-image reasoning benchmarks and show that it preserves 94.4% of full-resolution accuracy, demonstrating that input-aware visual scaling can substantially improve efficiency while maintaining strong multi-image reasoning performance.

blocks.en: We address image interactions using a three-round procedure: independent ascending search, joint verification, and iterative relaxation (Algorithm 1 ). For each image, we sweep Levels 0 0 – 4 4 and select the first level that yields a correct MLLM response, without assuming monotonic accuracy across resolutions. Single-image samples require at most five forward passes plus a pre-check, while multi-image samples cost O ⁡ ( 5 ​ N + K ​ N ) O(5N+KN) in the worst case. With K = 5 K=5 , joint verification succeeds without relaxation for most samples, so the average cost remains close to independent search. Label generation is performed once offline, and the resulting labels are reused across training runs and hyperparameter sweeps. A text-only ablation assigns nearly uniform levels, showing that meaningful allocation requires modeling the query × \times image-content interaction through multi-resolution MLLM evaluation.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Training Label Generation
blocks.zh: 算法 1 培训标签生成

blocks.en: The labels produced by Algorithm 1 are sufficient feasible allocations , not provably minimal ones. The ascending sweep finds the first working level per image without assuming that correctness is monotonic in resolution; even if a higher level were to fail due to MLLM stochasticity, the returned level is verified correct. Note that the pre-check (line 1) guarantees that full resolution produces the correct answer; consequently, both the Round 1 sweep (which tests each image at level 4 while others remain at full resolution) and the line 29 fallback to ( 4 , … , 4 ) (4,\ldots,4) are guaranteed to be valid. No sample that fails at full resolution enters the label generation pipeline. For multi-image samples, the greedy relaxation in Round 3 searches single-image increments and then uniform increments, which may not discover the cheapest subset combination (e.g., two images needing simultaneous promotion). This means the returned allocation can over-allocate relative to the true joint minimum. Crucially, this bias is conservative : labels may assign more tokens than strictly necessary but never fewer, since every returned vector is verified to produce the correct answer. For training, conservative labels are preferable to aggressive ones they train the predictor toward accuracy preservation rather than over-compression. The ordinal loss further tolerates label noise: a label of Level 3 when the true minimum is Level 2 incurs only one incorrect threshold, producing a mild penalty rather than a catastrophic gradient signal.

blocks.en: Baselines and Ablations. We compare against four post-encoding token-reduction baselines: VisionZip Yang et al. (2026) (attention-based, 65% dominant + 5% contextual tokens), ToFu Pippi et al. (2025) (dynamic token fusion via similarity merging), VisionTrim Yu et al. (2026) (dominant selection + text-guided complement, retaining ∼ \sim 30%), and ZooPrune Kim et al. (2026) (zeroth-order gradient token pruning with keep ratio 0.11). All operate after the full ViT forward pass and cannot reduce encoder compute. We also report Full Res. (upper bound), Uniform (all images at 512 × \times 512), Lower Bound (all images at 32 × \times 32), Random (levels sampled from GT distribution), and mmVB SI {}_{\text{SI}} (our predictor trained on single-image VQA only, to quantify the benefit of multi-image training data). Main Results. Table 1 compares mmVB against post-encoding baselines. mmVB achieves the highest harmonic mean on six of eight benchmarks (average HM of 0.90), retaining 94.4% of full-resolution accuracy while reducing visual tokens by 9.2 × \times and prefill FLOPs by 7.3 × \times (geometric mean across benchmarks). ZooPrune attains the best HM on MIBench and Visual Haystacks, where its aggressive token pruning (keep ratio 0.11) yields strong accuracy–compression trade-offs; however, it still requires a full ViT forward pass and cannot reduce encoder compute. VisionTrim is the strongest post-encoding baseline in accuracy, matching or exceeding mmVB on MIBench and MIRB, but it consumes 1.5–9.1 × \times more tokens per sample than mmVB to achieve comparable accuracy. Even on benchmarks where mmVB trails VisionTrim by 1–4 points in accuracy, mmVB uses 4–9 × \times fewer tokens and 4–7 × \times fewer prefill FLOPs, yielding substantially higher HM. VisionZip achieves strong compression on few-image benchmarks (e.g., 8.3 × \times on NLVR2) but retains most tokens on multi-image inputs (1.2 × \times on Visual Haystacks), yielding inconsistent efficiency. ToFu collapses on benchmarks requiring cross-image reasoning (Visual Haystacks, MMIU) where query-unaware merging discards discriminative content. Critically, all post-encoding methods pay full ViT cost regardless of predicted importance; mmVB’s pre-encoding resolution selection saves both encoder and LLM compute, aligning with findings that resolution reduction outperforms post-encoding compression at matched budgets Liao et al. (2026) . Ablation Study. Table 3 isolates each component’s contribution. The Random baseline samples levels from the ground-truth distribution but assigns them without regard to image content or query; it uses fewer tokens than mmVB on every benchmark because it randomly under-allocates to query-relevant images, but this results in substantially lower accuracy (e.g., 58.3% vs. 62.9% on MuirBench, 70.0% vs. 82.8% on NLVR2). The accuracy gap confirms that mmVB’s higher token usage reflects meaningful allocation to images that need it, not inefficiency. For a controlled comparison at matched budgets, see Figure 3 . Adding multi-image training data (MI vs. SI) improves accuracy on all benchmarks except ReMI, with the largest gains on Visual Haystacks (+5.7pp) and NLVR2 (+3.6pp), where cross-image reasoning is critical. mmVB for Budget-Constrained Token Allocation. The default mmVB pipeline predicts the minimum token level for each image independently. In deployment, however, the total visual-token budget may be fixed by latency, memory, throughput, or cost constraints. We therefore extend mmVB to distribute an arbitrary total budget across all input images using its ordinal predictions. Given a total budget B B , the allocation must satisfy ∑ i = 1 N b i ≤ B . \sum_{i=1}^{N}b_{i}\leq B. Starting from the lowest level for all images, we greedily select the promotion with the highest u i , k / Δ ​ b k u_{i,k}/\Delta b_{k} and repeat until the budget is exhausted. This training-free procedure approximates a multiple-choice knapsack solution, prioritizing query-relevant images while leaving less relevant images at lower resolutions. As shown in Figure 3 , this query-conditioned allocation consistently outperforms uniform allocation under the same total budget and can recover full accuracy with substantially fewer tokens. These results show that visual-token efficiency depends not only on how many tokens are retained, but also on how they are distributed across images.

blocks.en: To test whether mmVB’s learned resolution decisions reflect task-relevant visual information needs rather than model-specific artifacts, we evaluate with three black-box models that mmVB has never seen during training: Qwen3.5-27B, Claude Opus 4.6, and Pixtral Large. Images are resized according to mmVB’s predicted levels (trained solely on Qwen3.5-4B), then passed directly to each model’s API with no adaptation or fine-tuning. Qwen3.5-27B preserves 92.9% accuracy with 9.1 × \times visual token reduction; Claude Opus 4.6 preserves 89.8% with 3.9 × \times input token reduction; Pixtral Large preserves 89.9% with 4.8 × \times input token reduction (geometric means across benchmarks). This demonstrates that the resolution decisions generalize across architectures and scales, suggesting mmVB captures intrinsic image–query complexity rather than overfitting to the training model’s visual encoder. We note that these results represent a lower bound on achievable performance: training a model-specific predictor (e.g., distilling from Qwen3.5-27B’s own responses) would likely yield tighter accuracy retention, as the predictor could learn that model’s particular sensitivity to resolution changes.

Quen3.5-27B 保留92.9%的精度,9.1×x\times可视还原; Claude Opus 4.6 保留89.8%,3.9×x\times 输入还原; Pixtral Large 保留89.9%,4.8×x\times 输入还原(跨基准的几何表示). 这表明,决议决定概括了各种结构和尺度,建议mmVB捕捉内在的图像-平分复杂,而不是过于适合培训模型的视觉编码器。 我们注意到,这些结果对可实现性能的影响较小:培训一个具体模型的预测器(例如,从Quen3.5-27B本身的答复中提炼出)可能会产生更严格的准确性保留,因为预测器可以了解该模型对分辨率变化的特殊敏感性。

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Our work relates to visual token compression, visual resampling, multi-image reasoning, and efficient attention. Prior methods reduce visual-token cost through pruning, merging, or compact representations Rao et al. (2021) ; Bolya et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2025) ; Shang et al. (2026) ; Li et al. (2024c) ; Li et al. (2024b) ; Cai et al. (2024) ; Xing et al. (2025) ; Hu et al. (2026) ; Shen et al. (2024) ; Han et al. (2025) ; Renggli et al. (2022) . However, recent work suggests that simple input downsampling can outperform several post-encoding compression methods at matched compression ratios Liao et al. (2026) . Most approaches also process each image independently, rather than allocating a shared, question-conditioned token budget across multiple images. Latent resampling methods such as BLIP-2, Perceiver IO, and Flamingo map visual inputs into compact token sets Li et al. (2023) ; Jaegle et al. (2022) ; Alayrac et al. (2022) , but typically use a fixed budget per image. Multi-image models, including Mantis, LLaVA-NeXT-Interleave, LLaVA-OneVision, LongVA, and MuRAG, improve reasoning over multiple images or long multimodal contexts Jiang et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2024a) ; Zhang et al. (2024a) ; Chen et al. (2022) , but do not explicitly adapt token allocation to question relevance. AVAM Zeng et al. (2025) introduces query-conditioned visual anchoring for multi-image QA, but targets accuracy improvement rather than efficiency: its collaborative decoding mechanism runs both global and compressed visual branches, increasing inference cost. In contrast, mmVB operates before encoding and reduces both vision-encoder and LLM compute in a single forward pass. MIRAGE Wu et al. (2025) uses visual retrieval to select which images to process, scaling to thousands of images by discarding irrelevant ones entirely; mmVB instead retains all images but allocates different token budgets, which is necessary for tasks where every image may contribute (e.g., comparison, counting). Efficient attention methods such as FlashAttention and FlashAttention-2 reduce long-context memory and computation Dao et al. (2022) ; Dao (2023) , although they make attention-map-based pruning less practical. Overall, existing methods often use fixed budgets, operate on images independently, require attention-score access, or train new visual-language interfaces Lee et al. (2026) ; Kim et al. (2026) ; Alvar et al. (2025) ; Kimhi et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) ; Ye et al. (2025) ; Lee et al. (2024) ; Choudhury et al. (2024) ; Wei et al. (2023) ; Zhou et al. (2026) ; Xie et al. (2026) ; Rubab et al. (2026) ; Ding et al. (2023) ; Chen et al. (2023) ; Ryoo et al. (2021) ; Lei et al. (2025) ; Eliopoulos et al. (2025) . In contrast, we introduce lightweight, plug-and-play visual budgeting for multi-image reasoning that is question-conditioned, requires no base-model retraining, and avoids dense attention-map access at inference time.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented mmVB, a plug-and-play module that assigns query-aware token budgets before visual encoding. It achieves 9 × \times token reduction, 7 × \times fewer prefill FLOPs, and 5 × \times faster TTFT while retaining 94.4% accuracy, with negligible latency and strong cross-model transfer.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了mmVB,一个插件和游戏模块,在可视化编码之前分配出有查询意识的符号预算. 它在保持94.4%的精度的同时,实现了9×\时令牌减少,7×\时会减少预填FLOP,5×\时会加快TTFT,同时保持可忽略不计的空闲和强大的跨型相传.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en: The scale predictor is trained exclusively on natural-image QA datasets (VQAv2, TextVQA, GQA). Domains with fundamentally different resolution requirements, such as medical imaging where diagnostically relevant features may occupy only a few pixels within a high-resolution scan, are not represented in the training distribution. In such domains, the predictor may under-allocate tokens because it has not learned that subtle fine-grained features (e.g., lesion boundaries, microcalcifications) require full resolution regardless of query type. See Figure 5 for examples.
blocks.zh: 比例表预测器专门接受自然成像QA数据集(VQAv2,TextVQA,GQA)的培训. 具有根本不同分辨率要求的领域,如医学成像,在高分辨率扫描中,诊断相关特征可能只占据了少数像素,但在培训分发中没有体现. 在这类领域,预测器可能分配不足指使符,因为它还没有得知微妙的细微分辨特征(如损伤边界,微分解)需要完全解析而不管查询类型如何. 例子见图5。

blocks.en: Appendix A Architecture Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 建筑细节

blocks.en: Each image is encoded by a frozen ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNet-B0 backbone Tan and Le (2019) . Its 1280-dimensional feature is projected to the shared dimension d = 256 d=256 using a linear layer and dropout. Processing low-resolution thumbnails with EfficientNet-B0 is substantially cheaper than applying the MLLM vision encoder to every image.
blocks.zh: 每个图像由被冷冻的ImageNet-pressed ExecutiveNet-B0骨干Tan和Le(2019)编码. 其1280维的特征被预测为共用维度d=256d=256,使用线性地层并退出. 用高效Net-B0处理低分辨率缩略图比在每个图像上应用MLLM视觉编码器要便宜得多.

blocks.en: The query Q Q is tokenized and passed through the frozen MLLM embedding layer. The resulting d LLM d_{\text{LLM}} -dimensional token representations are mean-pooled and projected to the shared space by Linear ⁡ ( d LLM , 64 ) \operatorname{Linear}(d_{\text{LLM}},64) , ReLU, Dropout ⁡ ( 0.3 ) \operatorname{Dropout}(0.3) , Linear ⁡ ( 64,256 ) \operatorname{Linear}(64,256) , and LayerNorm. The narrow bottleneck limits memorization and encourages the retention of task-relevant query information.
blocks.zh: 查询Q Q是象征性的,经过被冻结的MLLM嵌入层. 由此产生的 d LLM d_{\text {LLM}}-维度符号表示符由 Linear ⁡ (d LLM, 64)\operatorname{Linear}(d_{\text{LLM}},64),ReLU, Dropout ⁡ (0.3)\operatorname{Dropout}(0.3), Linear ⁡ (64,256)\operatorname{Linear}(64,256),以及 TeryNorm 组合到共享空间. 狭窄的瓶颈限制了记忆,并鼓励保留与任务相关的查询信息.

blocks.en: The query embedding and N N image embeddings form a sequence of N + 1 N+1 tokens with dimension 256 256 . A two-layer Transformer encoder with four attention heads and a feed-forward dimension of 512 512 performs query-conditioned and cross-image reasoning, allowing each image to estimate both its required visual detail and its relative importance.
blocks.zh: 查询嵌入和N N 映像嵌入会形成一个以维度为256 256的N + 1 N + 1 符号的序列. 双层变形器编码器有四个注意头和512 512的向导维度,执行有查询条件和跨图像推理,使每个图像既能估计其所需的视觉细节,又能估计其相对重要性.

blocks.en: Each image representation is passed through an MLP with dimensions 256 → 64 → 4 256\rightarrow 64\rightarrow 4 . The four outputs define cumulative ordinal-regression thresholds P ⁡ ( ℓ i ≥ k ) = σ ⁡ ( z i , k ) , k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 } , P(\ell_{i}\geq k)=\sigma(z_{i,k}),\qquad k\in\{1,2,3,4\}, and the predicted level is ℓ ^ i = ∑ k = 1 4 𝕀 [ σ ( z i , k ) > 0.5 ] . \hat{\ell}_{i}=\sum_{k=1}^{4}\mathbb{I}\left[\sigma(z_{i,k})>0.5\right]. The four thresholds are trained independently without an explicit monotonicity constraint. While independent sigmoids can produce non-monotone probabilities, the thresholding rule above always yields a valid level; in practice, violations are infrequent because the ordinal loss encourages consistent threshold ordering.

Each image is resized according to its predicted token level, with the target resolution capped at the original dimensions to avoid upscaling. The budgeter processes only N + 1 N+1 tokens through two Transformer layers, adding approximately 2 ​ ms 2\mathrm{ms} of overhead. It contains about 1.6 1.6 million trainable parameters: 328k in the image projection, 181k in the text encoder, 1,054k in the Transformer, and 17k in the resolution head. The frozen EfficientNet-B0 adds 5.3 million parameters. The MLLM embedding layer must also remain in memory, but introduces no additional cost when co-deployed with the target MLLM.
blocks.zh: 每个图像会根据其预测的符号级别来调整大小,目标分辨率会以原尺寸为上限来避免提升. 预算器只通过两个变形器层处理 N + 1 N + 1 令牌,增加大约 2 ms 2\ mathrm{ms} 的间接费用. 它包含约160万个可被训练参数:图像投影328k,文本编码器181k,变形器1054k,分辨率头17k. 被冻结的高效网-B0增加了530万个参数. MLLM嵌入层也必须留在内存中,但与目标MLLM协同部署时不会引入额外费用.

blocks.en: We select EfficientNet-B0 as the frozen image encoder because it offers the best accuracy among models at the ∼ \sim 5M parameter scale (77.1% ImageNet top-1), outperforming MobileNetV2 (72.0%), MobileNetV3-Large (75.2%), and DeiT-Tiny (72.2%). TinyViT-5M achieves higher accuracy (79.1%) but requires 3.3 × \times more compute; since the encoder processes N N thumbnails per sample, this overhead compounds. Because the backbone is frozen, parameter count is immaterial; only representation quality matters for downstream level prediction. The remaining hyperparameters were selected via validation performance on the token-based training set (Table 4 ). Two Transformer layers provide sufficient capacity for cross-image reasoning without overfitting; a single layer under-performs on multi-image benchmarks where relative importance must be inferred. Five ordinal levels match the natural 4 × \times token gaps in vision encoders, providing meaningful resolution distinctions at each step. The 64-dim text bottleneck restricts information flow from the 2560-dim LLM embeddings; wider bottlenecks memorize per-sample query identity while narrower ones discard task-type signal.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了高效Net-B0作为被冻结的图像编码器,因为它在\\sim 5M参数尺度(77.1%的ImageNet上1),优于MobileNetV2(72.0%),MobileNetV3-Large(75.2%)和DeiT-Tiny(72.2%)的模型中提供了最佳的准确性。 TinyViT-5M能实现更高的精度(79.1%),但需要3.3×\times更能计算;由于编码器每个样本处理N缩略图,这种高通化合物. 由于骨干被冻结,参数计数无关紧要;只有表现质量关系下游水平预测. 其余的超参数是通过在以符号为基础的培训集上的验证性能选定的(表4)。 两个变相器层为跨相图推理提供了足够的能力而不会过于相合;一个单相图层在多相图基准上表现不佳,必须推断出相对的重要性. 五个正数级匹配了视觉编码器中天然的 4 ×\times 符号相差,在每个步骤上提供了有意义的分辨率区分. 64-dim文本瓶颈限制了来自2560-dim LLM嵌入的信息流;更广泛的瓶颈会记住每个样本的查询身份,而更窄的会丢弃任务类型的信号.

blocks.en: B.1 Per-task performance breakdown
blocks.zh: B.1 每项任务的业绩细目

blocks.en: Figure 6 shows that mmVB closely follows Full-res across most tasks for every benchmarks. Uniform downsampling causes uneven degradation, with the largest drops on detail-sensitive tasks such as Charts, 3D Pose, Person ReID, and visual chain reasoning. Coarser tasks remain relatively stable even at lower resolutions. Post-encoding baselines show greater task-level variation and occasional failures, while ReMI remains challenging for all methods, especially on numerical reasoning tasks. Overall, mmVB preserves most of the Full-res performance while using substantially fewer visual tokens.
blocks.zh: 图6显示,每个基准在大多数任务中,mmVB都密切跟踪Full-res。 统一下采样会导致不均匀的退化,在细节敏感的任务上降得最多,如Charts,3D Pose,Person ReID,和视觉链推理等. 即使在分辨率更低的情况下,煤炭任务仍然相对稳定。 编码后基线显示任务级别差异较大,偶尔出现故障,而ReMI对所有方法,尤其是数字推理任务,仍然具有挑战性. 总体来说,mmVB保留了大部分Full-res的性能,同时使用远为较少的视觉符号.

blocks.en: B.2 mmVB performance on Single Image

Since many standard benchmarks, such as VQAv2 and TextVQA, focus on general visual question answering, we select MM-Vet and POPE to assess transferability to single-image settings. MM-Vet evaluates the integration of core vision-language capabilities, including recognition, OCR, knowledge, language generation, spatial reasoning, and mathematics. blocks.en: We evaluate multi-image reasoning on eight complementary benchmarks spanning diverse tasks, image counts, and reasoning demands. Table 6 summarizes the eight benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们对涉及不同任务、图像计数和推理要求的8个互补基准的多图像推理进行评价。 表6汇总了8个基准。

blocks.en: C.2 MuirBench
blocks.zh: C.2 穆尔本奇

blocks.en: MuirBench Wang et al. (2025) contains 11,264 images and 2,600 multiple-choice questions across 12 tasks. Each question requires joint reasoning over 2–7 images and covers relations such as narrative, temporal, complementary, cropped or zoomed, and multi-view scenes. Tasks include geographic and diagram understanding, retrieval, counting, difference spotting, and action understanding. The benchmark tests whether models reason across images rather than rely on single-image shortcuts.
blocks.zh: 穆尔·本奇 王等编. (2025)包含11,264个图像和2,600个多选题,涉及12个任务. 每个问题都需要在2到7个图像上进行联合推理,并涵盖叙述、时间、互补、裁剪或放大以及多景等关系。 任务包括地理和图表理解,检索,计数,差分分分取出,以及动作理解等. 基准测试模型是否在图像之间理性,而不是依赖单一图像快捷键.

blocks.en: C.3 MIBench
blocks.zh: C.3. MI Bench先生(美国)

blocks.en: MIBench Liu et al. (2024) contains 5,000 multiple-choice questions across five categories: comparison, subtle difference detection, temporal reasoning, logical reasoning, and visual referring. Samples use text-rich documents, natural photographs, and synthetic scenes. The benchmark evaluates whether multi-image models can follow varied instructions over image sets.
blocks.zh: MI Bench Liu等 (2024)包含有5000个多选择问题,涉及5个类别:比较,微妙差异检测,时间推理,逻辑推理,和视觉参考. 样本使用丰富的文字文件,自然相片,和合成场景. 该基准评价多图像模型能否在图像集上遵循不同的指令.

blocks.en: C.4 Mantis-Eval
blocks.zh: C.4 螳螂-Eval

blocks.en: Mantis-Eval Jiang et al. (2024) contains 217 human-annotated problems in multiple-choice and short-answer formats. Each sample includes 2–5 images and covers common-sense, complex, logical, and fine-grained visual reasoning. Despite its small size, the benchmark is difficult: GPT-4V achieves 62.67%.
blocks.zh: 蚯蚓- Eval 蒋等(2024)以多选取和短答形式收录了217个被人注解出的问题. 每个样本包括2–5个图像,并覆盖了常识,复杂,逻辑和精细的视觉推理. 尽管规模较小,但基准难度很大:GPT-4V实现62.67%.

blocks.en: C.5 NLVR2
blocks.zh: C.5 净消费量2

blocks.en: NLVR2 Suhr et al. (2019) evaluates reasoning over image pairs. Each sample presents two photographs and a natural-language statement that must be classified as True or False . The statements require reasoning about object properties, spatial relations, comparison, counting, and set-level quantification. The test set contains 6,967 samples, including 3,558 true and 3,409 false instances.
blocks.zh: 净消费量2 苏尔等. (2019)评价推理比图像对. 每个样本都呈现出两张照片和一个自然语言的语句,必须被归类为"真"或"假". 语句需要对对象属性,空间关系,比较,计数,以及设定层次量化进行推理. 测试集包含6,967个样本,包括3,558个真实和3,409个假例.

blocks.en: C.6 Visual Haystacks
blocks.zh: C.6 视觉海斯塔克

blocks.en: Visual Haystacks Wu et al. (2025) is a vision-centric Needle-In-A-Haystack benchmark for large multimodal models. Each sample mixes a small set of “needle” images with distractors and asks whether all or any needle images also contain a target object. The full dataset contains 20,100 samples with 1 to more than 10,000 images. We cap each haystack at 10 images by retaining all positives and randomly sampling negatives. The benchmark tests retrieval and reasoning over large image sets.
blocks.zh: 视觉海斯塔克 Wu等 (2025年)是大型多式模型以视觉为中心的Needle-In-A-Haystack基准. 每个样本将一小组"需要"图像与分心器相混合,并询问所有或任何针头图像是否也包含一个目标对象. 完整的数据集包含有20,100个样本,并有1到10,000多幅图像. 我们把每个干草堆封为10个图像 通过保留所有阳性 和随机抽样的阴性。 基准测试大型图像集的检索和推理。

blocks.en: C.7 MMIU
blocks.zh: C.7 毛里求斯

blocks.en: MMIU Meng et al. (2025) contains 93,584 samples, 77,659 images, and about 52 tasks spanning semantic, temporal, and spatial relations. Tasks include forensic detection, correspondence, temporal ordering, action assessment, jigsaw solving, 3D pose estimation, and Raven’s matrices. Each sample contains 1–62 images and a multiple-choice question with up to 10 options. The random baseline is 27.4%, and the best reported model, GPT-4o, achieves 55.7%.
blocks.zh: 马里 孟等编. (2025年)包含93,584个样本,77,659个图像,以及大约52个涉及语义,时间和空间关系的任务. 任务包括法医侦测、通信、时间命令、行动评估、拼图解析、3D姿势估计和Raven的矩阵。 每个样本包含1-62个图像和一个多选择问题,最多可有10个选项. 随机基准为27.4%,最佳报告模型GPT-4o实现55.7%.

blocks.en: C.8 MIRB
blocks.zh: C.8 MIRB项目

blocks.en: MIRB Zhao et al. (2024) contains 1,124 samples across 14 tasks covering perception, knowledge, reasoning, and multi-hop reasoning. Tasks include visual analogy, cross-image counting, multi-view 3D understanding, code and paper comprehension, ingredient analysis, jigsaw puzzles, plot interpretation, landmark recognition, and visual chain reasoning. Answer formats include multiple-choice, yes/no, counting, and free-form extraction.
blocks.zh: 米兰 赵等. (2024年)包含1,124个样本,涉及14个任务,包括感知,知识,推理,和多跳推理. 任务包括视觉类比,跨图像计数,多视图3D理解,代码和纸张理解,成分分析,拼图谜题,情节解释,地标识别,和视觉链推理. 答案格式包括多选择,是/否,计数,和自由形式取出.

blocks.en: C.9 ReMI
blocks.zh: C.9 缩略语

blocks.en: ReMI Kazemi et al. (2024) contains 2,600 samples across 13 mathematical, spatial, temporal, and logical reasoning tasks. These include Charts, Clocks, CodeEdit, Collisions, EmojiAlgebra, FuncRead, GeomCost, GeomShape, IQ, Isomorphism, Maps, RefCoco, and Schedule. Each sample contains 2–6 images and requires a short free-form answer. ReMI emphasizes quantitative and structured reasoning rather than visual matching alone.
blocks.zh: ReMI Kazemi等(2024年)包含有2600个样本,涉及13个数学,空间,时间,逻辑推理任务. 其中包括"图","时钟","代码编辑","碰撞","EmojiAlgebra","FuncRead","GeomCost","GeomShape","IQ","Isomorphism","地图","RefCoco"等. 每个样本包含2-6个图像,需要简短的自由式答案. ReMI强调定量和有结构的推理,而不是光是视觉相配.

blocks.en: Single-image (484k samples): VQAv2, TextVQA, GQA covering natural scenes, text-heavy images, and compositional reasoning respectively. Multi-image (50k samples from Mantis-Instruct): 17 subsets including NLVR2, LLaVA-multi, spot-the-diff, visual storytelling, coinstruct, and others, covering 2–10+ images per sample with diverse multi-image reasoning tasks.

blocks.en: Samples where the MLLM answers incorrectly at full resolution are discarded, as they provide no valid signal for minimum-resolution search. Generation is parallelized across 8 GPUs with manifest sharding for throughput.
blocks.zh: MLLM在完全解析时答错的样本被丢弃,因为它们没有为最小解析度搜索提供有效的信号. 在8个GPU中,世代制是平行的,通过量明显减少。
